# The Technological System

*[Jacques Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) · 1977*

[Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) shows there that techniques, linked by computing, now form a system, the [technological system](../glossary/technological-system.md), which has become humanity's very milieu in place of nature, and which grows according to its own logic.
